messages:
lee: Midnight cutover tonight 00:30 UTC. Quick brief + standby rotations below. Please ack if you're on. I'll be deploy lead.

lee: Cutover plan (short):
- 00:10: preflight checks
- 00:20: narrow rollout 2% prod traffic
- 00:30: ramp to 20% then 100% over 10m if stable
- Rollback plan: immediate rollback to vX on any P50 latency regression >150ms or error spike

maria: I'm deploy lead with lee. Will run preflight at 00:10. I'll post results here.

sam: I'll smoke test and run DB feature flag toggle. Where's the runbook link?

lee: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/midnight-cutover-2026 (priv net)

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation tonight -> nora (primary), kevin (backup). Escalation page: https://redwood.internal/oncall

nora: Acked. I'll be on pager and watching latency dashboards.

kevin: Ack. If rollback needed I can patch routing and scale replicas.

aida-ci: Deploy scheduled by maria at 2026-03-17T00:30Z. CI status: all green.

maria: Preflight checklist (quick):
```
# preflight
make smoke-test
./scripts/check-queues.sh
python infra/validate_configs.py --env=prod
```

sam: I'll tail logs and run `kubectl logs -f` for the worker pods. Also pre-warm caches.

lee: Security confirm: KMS key rotated and access for deploy role validated by kevin?

kevin: Confirmed. Keys in vault, policies in place.

maria: Preflight ok: smoke-test pass, queues clear, infra validate ok. Posting artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/cutover/1719000000

sam: Smoke tests passed from my side. DB toggle dry-run ok.

nora: Dashboards look clean. No high-error alerts in last hour.

lee: Final call — thumbs? Reply with :thumbsup: to greenlight.

maria: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

nora: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

lee: OK launching narrow rollout at 00:20 UTC. I'll post status updates. If anyone sees issues tag @nora or ping me directly.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: lane=narrow-2pct, version=2026.03.17-rc1

maria: Status @ 00:22 — metrics within expected ranges, no errors spike.

sam: Logs look good. ramping to 20% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: lane=20pct, progress=100%, stable

lee: Ramp to 100% starting now. Keeping watch for 10m.

nora: Monitoring. No regressions.

maria: All done. Cutover complete. Posting post-deploy checklist: run smoke test, sanity check endpoints, notify product.

sam: Notifying product and CS.

lee: Thanks team. If any post-deploy issues open a thread in #incidents and tag me.

kevin: Standby release notes patch scheduled for tomorrow.

ops-bot: OT reminder: rotation ends at 08:00 UTC. Thanks everyone.
